item.title: MEDAL COUNT: Who's topping the table in the 2026 Milan Cortina Olympics?
item.description: With 116 medal events in total, KXAN is keeping track of how many medals each participating team has won.

item.title: Texas man was fatally shot by a federal immigration agent last year during a stop, new records show
item.description: Newly released records show a U.S. citizen was shot and killed in Texas by a federal immigration agent last year during a late-night traffic encounter that was not publicly disclosed by the Department of Homeland Security.

item.title: Southwest to launch four new nonstop routes from Austin in October
item.description: Southwest Airlines is continuing its expansion efforts at Austin-Bergstrom International Airport, with four new nonstop routes planned for October.

item.title: Ethan Mendoza powers Texas baseball past Michigan State in series opener
item.description: Ethan Mendoza sparked Texas with a home run, a double and three RBIs, while Ruger Riojas struck out 10 as the Longhorns cruised past Michigan State 8–1 in the series opener at Disch-Falk Field.

item.title: No. 3 Texas takes down ranked opponents at DeMarini Invitational
item.description: No. 3 Texas opened the DeMarini Invitational with two statement wins, routing No. 16 Arizona and edging No. 10 Stanford behind Katie Stewart’s pair of home runs and standout pitching from Teagan Kavan.

item.title: Restitution, reform possible for men cleared in Austin's yogurt shop murders
item.description: AUSTIN (KXAN) -- The original suspects in Austin's infamous yogurt shop murders case and their families can look ahead to possible restitution and reform after a judge signed orders clearing their names. New evidence presented by the Austin Police Department points to another man, Robert Brashers, as the lone suspect in the crime decades after [...]

item.title: Texas attorney general sues New York company Lola Olivia, says its chest binders are 'medical devices'
item.description: The lawsuit said the business illegally marketed its compression tops as safe for minors and for the purpose of gender transition.

item.title: Austin unveils homelessness strategy: Plans for 650 more shelter beds, new navigation centers
item.description: Next week, Austin City Council is expected to vote on a strategic plan for Austin's Homeless Strategies and Operations Office that sets the office's priorities over the next couple years.

item.title: Fire risk Saturday before overnight freezes return
item.description: A Red Flag Warning has been issued for parts of Central Texas on Saturday from 10 a.m. until 9 p.m. -- Nick Bannin

item.title: Off-duty Austin officer shoots, kills man who opened fire inside barbershop, TCSO says
item.description: The Travis County Sheriff's Office said it responded to a homicide Friday night near the Pflugerville area.
